# costfluent_commitments (Data Source)

List the reservations, savings plans and committed use discounts held through a workspace's connections, narrowed to the accounts the workspace reads of each, by end date: earliest first, and those without an end last. Each filter matches ignoring case. Needs a token with `viewCosts` on the workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Commitments held through the provider's workspace's connections that end soon.
data "costfluent_commitments" "expiring" {
  status = "expiring"
}

output "expiring_commitments" {
  value = [for c in data.costfluent_commitments.expiring.commitments : "${c.type} ${c.id} ends ${c.ends_at}"]
}

# Three-year AWS Savings Plans, with how much of each went unused.
data "costfluent_commitments" "aws_savings_plans" {
  provider_key = "aws"
  type         = "SavingsPlan"
  term_years   = 3
}

output "savings_plan_utilization" {
  value = { for c in data.costfluent_commitments.aws_savings_plans.commitments : c.id => c.utilization_percentage }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `account` (String) Only commitments held in this account.
- `payment_option` (String) Only commitments paid this way: All Upfront, Partial Upfront or No Upfront.
- `provider_key` (String) Only commitments held through connections of this provider, such as aws, azure or gcp.
- `region` (String) Only commitments in this region.
- `service` (String) Only commitments for this service.
- `status` (String) Only commitments in this state: active, expiring, expired or unknown (no end stated).
- `term_years` (Number) Only commitments with this term, in years, such as 1 or 3.
- `type` (String) Only commitments of this type: ReservedInstance, SavingsPlan or CommittedUseDiscount.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID. Uses the provider's workspace if not specified.

### Read-Only

- `commitments` (Attributes List) The commitments, by end date. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--commitments))

<a id="nestedatt--commitments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `commitments`

Read-Only:

- `account` (String) The account that holds the commitment.
- `currency` (String) Currency of the commitment's amounts.
- `days_until_expiry` (Number) Whole days to the end; negative once ended, null without an end.
- `description` (String) What the commitment covers, as the provider describes it.
- `ends_at` (String) When the term ends; null when the provider states no end.
- `full_term_cost` (String) The cost of the whole term, in currency.
- `hourly_commitment` (String) The amount committed each hour, in currency.
- `id` (String) The provider's own ID of the commitment, as cost rows carry it.
- `last_read_at` (String) When Costfluent last read the commitment from the provider.
- `payment_option` (String) All Upfront, Partial Upfront or No Upfront.
- `provider_id` (String) The connection the commitment was read through.
- `provider_key` (String) The connection's provider, such as aws.
- `provider_name` (String) The connection's name.
- `provider_status` (String) The provider's own word for the commitment's state, such as Active or Retired.
- `region` (String) The region the commitment applies in.
- `service` (String) The service the commitment applies to.
- `starts_at` (String) When the term started.
- `status` (String) active, expiring, expired or unknown (no end stated).
- `term_years` (Number) The term, in years.
- `type` (String) ReservedInstance, SavingsPlan or CommittedUseDiscount.
- `unused_cost` (String) What the unused part cost over the utilization window, in currency.
- `utilization_from` (String) First day of the utilization window (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `utilization_percentage` (Number) The share of the commitment used over the utilization window, 0 to 100.
- `utilization_to` (String) Last day of the utilization window (YYYY-MM-DD).
